# `browser-extension/services/ResearchWindowLeaseService.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/services/ResearchWindowLeaseService.js`

Extension-owned, run-scoped research popup leases. Every operation revalidates the authenticated opener dispatch, normal-profile popup, complete owned tab set, allowed origin, top-frame document generation, bridge session, operator epoch, and signed Faculty action coordinates.
